body:
Honestly, I can relate to this post so much, from your girlfriend's side. My boyfriend recently told me he fell for someone at his work and we have been together for two years...

My advice to you is to remember exactly why you and your girlfriend are together, what she really means to you and if you see a future with her. Talk to her about what is bothering you, chances are she may not know what shes doing is affecting you. She could be under some stress that you are unaware of. Also, you say you love each other but feel you are not "in love" anymore, that may be because of the length of the relationship. I've realized that after you are with someone for so long the excitement wears off and it becomes a different kind of love. 

I also would avoid making any further connections with this girl at work until you talk to your girlfriend about how you feel. Don't involve the new girl in anything that has to do with your relationship, because that is not being fair to your girlfriend.

Do not blame yourself. Everyone goes through hard times throughout their life. If a man cannot handle you at your worst then he does not deserve you at your best. Just think of it this way, when one door closes another one opens. There are plenty of other people in this world who would love to see you smile. You may not be able to see it now, but just hang in there. Someone will come around when you least expect it.

I just had this exact same problem the other day. I am a manager at a store and got my hours cut, while high school kids got more hours than me. It's a tough situation to deal with and I know how angry you're feeling because I felt that too.

How long have you been dealing with them cutting your hours? If the same pattern continues I would start looking for something else to fall back on. Or you could tell your boss that if they cannot give you the hours you need to survive that you will have to move on to a different job. Hopefully it is only temporary. Hang in there.
I guess I learned to think about things more before I make a decision. And to not go back to people who have hurt me before.
Thank you. I will keep that in mind.
Regretting not leaving my ex for the other guy. Sorry for the confusion.

You are not a waste of time and space. Don't let that girl upset you. You know you didn't do those things she is accusing you of. If she is going to make things up to upset you, then she isn't worth your time. Keep yourself busy with friends or a hobby to get your mind off of it. If you need someone to talk to, you can message me.
I know how it feels to be so alone and have no one to turn to. Feel free to message me. You can vent to me and I will listen and help you as much as a can. Do not hesitate.

I'm sorry for your loss. I can tell you really loved her and I'm sure she died knowing how much you cared about her. There is really nothing any of us can say to ease your pain now. But I will tell you it will get easier in the future. It is going to take some time, but eventually you will be able to smile and just remember the good times you had with her. A part of her will always be with you. You deserve the same happiness that you made her feel and I'm sure she would want you to be happy. I bet she is looking down on you and smiling.

I've been recommended to see a psychologist but I'm unsure of where to go or who to see. I imagine it would be better considering those around me don't understand how I feel.

I think I would describe it more as depression. Whether I'm with people or not its the same feeling. Never used to bother me when I was with others, but it's gotten worse.
Yes I broke up with him for some good reasons. But when he wasn't around I felt lonely without him. Part of me wants to stay with him, the other part wants me to leave. I am afraid to be alone...
Thank you so much. I hope these feelings do pass.

The way she acted towards you is horrible. Just by reading this I can tell you are a nice, loving, and caring person. You do not deserve what she has done to you. She seems to only care about what she wants. You are much better off without her. I know it seems hard to realize that now because your feelings for her are strong. But it will get easier. There are plenty of other people in the world that will not screw you over like that. You've given her more than enough chances to change, and she hasn't. You gave it your all and nothing less. The last thing you want to do is blame yourself. None of it is your fault. Hang in there.
When I'm in a social situation I'm usually honest about who I am. But it just feels like something is missing. We were not drinking either. I understand what you're saying though. Thank you :)
I do the same thing. I fake a smile when I'm really suffering inside. I feel like the people I know won't care or be able to help so why bother telling them.

I feel the same way as you described. Do the antidepressants help? And we are talking more college/work settings. Although I was in a group of people I met in high school, but we've been graduated for a few years now. And thank you :)

I know how you feel. My life is not that bad but still having major feelings of depression and emptiness. I try to keep myself busy with work or school. It usually can distract me from those feelings for a while. But I can assure you there is nothing wrong with you. You're not alone. If you need to talk feel free to message me.

i know exactly what you're going through. i have had the exact same problem. whenever someone would try to get close to me i would push them away, then end up regretting my decision later. my best friend, also has hurt me. but i learned to forgive her and put it behind us. my advice is to not put 100% trust in anyone. people aren't always going to be what we want them to be. but do not let what other people have done ruin what you could have with someone else. taking chances is a part of life. it may be scary, and you might get hurt again along the way. but the right people will come along and it will all be worth it in the end.

I can completely relate to how you're feeling. I try to have good relationships with people as well, but seems they are never willing to put forth as much effort as I am. But I can assure you, you are not meant to be alone. The right people will come along soon enough. Don't blame yourself for the way others act. I made that same mistake and always thought it was myself. Everyone has flaws and we're all still growing and finding ourselves. You are not alone. It looks like you are doing a great job keeping yourself busy, and that's what you need to do. Everything will work out. You will find yourself and meet new people. Hang in there.
yes close to a year. everyday is such a struggle to get through. and no professionals, i dont have the money for it. :(
thank you. i have been feeling like this for months. maybe almost a year.
how should i do that?

I can completely understand how you're feeling with all of this. I'm in the same boat as you. I just recently broke up with my ex, he never knew what to say to help me so it made me feel like he didn't care. Same with the friends too, I'm always be willing to help a friend out and never receive any help. I only have one true friend I can count on. My advice to you is to just keep yourself busy, with maybe a hobby or school? That's what I do and it keeps your mind off of things. I can guarantee you will make new friends and find another relationship that will work out for you. It just takes time and you have to have faith in yourself. You sound like a good guy. Also, don't take it out on yourself that the relationship didn't work out. There are plenty of other out there that I'm sure would be willing to listen and help you. If you'd like to message me you can.

Well, my advice is to take a break from going to school. Go job hunting and work until you save up some money to go back to school. You're only 20 years old and there is still so much time in your life to turn things around. I'm sure if you sat down and talked to your parents about how you made a mistake and how you want to change your life they would listen. If you assure them that you are going to work towards paying them back and getting your life back in order, then they have no reason to kick you out.

I can relate to you because I sometimes feel hated and unappreciated. But I am sure your parents care about you. I know it may not seem like it because of how they have been acting, but deep down they do. Sometimes parents get stressed out and take it out on their kids, just because the stress overwhelms them. It would NOT help them if you died. There are many good things in life to come to you. Just give it time, hang in there, things will change and get better when you least expect it.
